name: attention-lab
description: Attention Lab — 14-day attention practice experiment. P0 prototype.

scripts.db:up: docker start attention-lab-pg || docker run -d --name attention-lab-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=devpassword -e POSTGRES_USER=attention -e POSTGRES_DB=attention_lab -p 55432:5432 postgres:17-alpine
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.build: npm run build -w @attention-lab/shared && npm run build -w @attention-lab/api && npm run build -w @attention-lab/web
